title: Open-source metabolism: acquire, qualify and integrate mature OSS before inventing
statement: Accelerate the full Egregore by systematically acquiring, qualifying, adapting, recombining and integrating the best available open-source technologies; distinguish discovered, legally and technically qualified, adapter implemented, installed, registered, attached, exercised and externally verified states; never install a parallel authority; measure success by new verified OSS-derived functions on the canonical GREG mission path.
source: Founder directive 'UNIIMENTE / GREG — OPUS MAXIMUS: OPEN-SOURCE METABOLISM, PARALLEL ENGINEERING AND RECURSIVE CAPABILITY ASCENT', chat, issued twice in session_013k41DnwrjzpXL33r3j9BgB
source_location: docs/open-source/OSS-METABOLISM-2026-10-22-excerpts.md (faithful verbatim excerpts; full chat text not exported)
intended_outcome: GREG gains functions from mature OSS with legal and technical qualification, isolated execution, independent verification, founder-governed attach, and competence credit; the anti-n8n acceptance test shows where GREG's institutional mechanisms beat simpler OSS workflows.
rationale: Directive sections 5, 6 and 13: acquisition before invention; legal and technical qualification are distinct states.
conflicts: None with INTENT-20260930-open-source-first; strengthens it. The policy that a founder-command attach of a license-held package should also refuse is unresolved and left to the founder.
owner: Alfonso Lopez (intent); session_013k41DnwrjzpXL33r3j9BgB (Open-Source Metabolism workstream implementation)
